 Michigan General Election Results 2026
 Michigan Public | 
 By
 Kalloli Bhatt 
 Published November 3, 2026 at 8:00 PM EST
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Email 
 Follow the latest Michigan election results for 2026 after polls close tonight across the state. See live vote totals and where candidates stand in their respective races, including Michigan governor , U.S. Senate , U.S. House, state Legislature, and other statewide offices.
 Polls close at 8 p.m. across Michigan . Four Upper Peninsula counties - Dickinson, Gogebic, Iron, and Menominee counties - are in Central Time, meaning their polls will close at 9 p.m. Eastern.
 Also check out our live updates from Michigan Public reporters across the state.
